requests.subject: free_agent_target
requests.note: The same request for the 2006 summer market, read by runtime/free_agency_2004.py for 2006 (this folder is the 2006 market's): if Ariza is still unsigned after 2005-06 (an unrestricted free agent, having played the season on his qualifying offer), Miami's front office moves him up its list by Wade's standing weight and may pay up to 110% of its valuation; it sets the terms, other clubs bid and Ariza answers by engine draw. Miami's 2006-07 commitments are $63,325,002 on the date, so without room the route is an exception (the mid-level of the 2006-07 rules once published). No term preference stated.
